children.name: infra.yaml
children.content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Trak AWS Cloud Architecture - Core VPC & Security Stack'

Resources:
  TrakVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Trak-Production-VPC

  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TrakVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [ 0, !GetAZs '' ]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Trak-Public-Subnet-A

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: Created VPC ID
    Value: !Ref TrakVPC

children.content:
# ☁️ Complete AWS Cloud Architecture & Solutions Track

Welcome to your full AWS learning workspace materialized with **Trak**.

## 📚 Comprehensive Module Index

| Module | Title | Key Topics Covered |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-global-infrastructure` | **Global Infrastructure** | Regions, AZs, Edge Locations, Local Zones, AWS CLI setup, `sts get-caller-identity` |
| `01-iam-and-identity-security` | **IAM & Zero-Trust Security** | JSON Policies (Effect, Action, Resource, Condition), Roles, SCPs, Permission Boundaries |
| `02-networking-vpc-and-routing` | **VPC & Routing Architecture** | CIDR design, Public/Private Subnets, IGW, NAT Gateway, Transit Gateway, VPC Endpoints |
| `03-network-security-sg-and-nacl` | **SG vs NACL Security** | Security Groups (Stateful) vs NACLs (Stateless), AWS WAF, Shield DDoS mitigation |
| `04-compute-ec2-and-ami-lifecycle`| **EC2 Compute & Graviton** | Instance families, Graviton ARM, AMIs, User Data, IMDSv2 metadata, Spot vs Savings |
| `05-load-balancing-and-auto-scaling`| **ELB & Auto-Scaling** | ALB (Layer 7) vs NLB (Layer 4), Target Groups, ASG scaling policies, Launch Templates |
| `06-storage-s3-and-glacier-tiers` | **S3 Object Storage & Tiers**| S3 Tiers (Standard, Intelligent, Glacier Deep Archive), Lifecycle rules, Object Lock |
| `07-block-and-file-storage-ebs-efs`| **EBS & EFS Storage** | EBS volume types (gp3, io2), Snapshots, EFS managed NFS, FSx for Lustre |
| `08-databases-rds-aurora-dynamodb` | **RDS, Aurora & DynamoDB** | RDS Multi-AZ vs Read Replicas, Aurora distributed storage, DynamoDB Single Table |
| `09-serverless-lambda-api-gateway` | **Serverless & Lambda** | AWS Lambda concurrency, Cold Starts vs Provisioned, API Gateway (REST, HTTP, WebSockets) |
| `10-event-driven-sns-sqs-eventbridge`| **Event-Driven Architecture** | SQS (Standard vs FIFO, DLQ), SNS pub/sub fanout, EventBridge event buses & schemas |
| `11-containers-ecs-fargate-eks` | **Containers (ECS & EKS)** | ECS Task Definitions, AWS Fargate serverless containers, EKS managed K8s, Karpenter |
| `12-iac-cdk-and-cloudformation` | **IaC (CDK & CloudFormation)**| CloudFormation Stacks, Change Sets, AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python code as infra) |
| `13-monitoring-cloudwatch-xray` | **CloudWatch & Observability** | Metrics, Alarms, Logs Insights, X-Ray distributed tracing, CloudTrail audit logs |
| `14-security-kms-secrets-and-waf` | **KMS, Secrets & Cryptography**| Envelope encryption, KMS CMK keys, Secrets Manager automatic rotation, SSM Parameter Store |
| `15-edge-cdn-cloudfront-route53` | **CloudFront & Route 53** | CloudFront CDN behaviors, Lambda@Edge, Route 53 routing policies (Latency, Geolocation) |
| `16-well-architected-and-finops` | **Well-Architected & FinOps** | 6 Pillars of Well-Architected Framework, Cost Explorer, Budgets, Reserved Instances |
| `17-interview-questions-and-drills`| **Interview Master Drill** | Top 10 AWS Solutions Architect & DevOps interview scenarios & design challenges |

---

# 00 - AWS Global Infrastructure 🛠️

- **Regions**: Geographically isolated areas containing $\ge 3$ Availability Zones.
- **Availability Zones (AZs)**: One or more discrete data centers with redundant power, networking, and low-latency interconnects.
- **Edge Locations**: Global network of PoPs (Points of Presence) delivering cached content via CloudFront CDN and Route 53.

children.content:
# 03 - Security Groups vs Network ACLs

| Feature | Security Group (SG) | Network ACL (NACL) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Operating Level** | Instance (ENI) level | Subnet level |
| **Statefulness** | **Stateful** (Return traffic automatically allowed) | **Stateless** (Inbound & outbound must be explicitly allowed) |
| **Rules Allowed** | Allow rules only | Allow AND Deny rules |
| **Rule Evaluation**| All rules evaluated together | Evaluated in numerical order (Lowest rule number wins) |

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 17 - High-Yield AWS Solutions Architect & DevOps Interview Questions 🎯

### Top 5 Interview Questions:
1. **RDS Multi-AZ vs Read Replicas**: Multi-AZ is synchronous replication to a standby instance in another AZ for Disaster Recovery (no performance gain); Read Replicas are asynchronous for scaling read queries.
2. **Security Groups vs NACLs**: SGs are stateful at the ENI instance level; NACLs are stateless at the subnet boundary evaluated numerically.
3. **VPC Peering Transitive Routing**: VPC Peering does NOT support transitive routing (If A peers with B and B with C, A cannot talk to C without a Transit Gateway or direct peering).
4. **S3 Strong Consistency**: S3 provides strong read-after-write consistency for PUTs and DELETEs of objects in all regions.
5. **Lambda Cold Starts**: The latency penalty when AWS initializes a new microVM execution environment, downloadable container image, and runtime before executing handler code.

🚀 You have completed the complete AWS Cloud Architecture & Solutions Engineering track!
